hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout; no head-hopping or omniscient narration (project contract: POV_structure Single POV — Ben Skywalker throughout).

'Jedi' singular and plural, never 'Jedis'; 'Darth' capitalized before name (canon_constraints: style_constraints).
Avoid forbidden repeat phrases like 'reached for the Force' (force_mechanics: vocabulary_variation: forbidden_repeat_phrases).
